title: Optimize: launch enablement kit — battlecards, FAQs, talk tracks & demo scripts
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Purpose: Produce a sales & customer success (CS) enablement kit for the Optimize: intelligent batching & caching recommendations feature (optimize-1.0). The kit should allow AE/SE and CS to: 1) quickly understand technical benefits and unit-economics impact, 2) run a short product demo showing latency/cost trade-offs, and 3) answer common customer objections. Deliverables: battlecards (AE/SE), one-pager FAQ for CS, two talk-track variants (executive & technical), three demo scripts (quick pitch, deep-dive, migration proof-of-value), a Slack-ready announcement, and a release-notes coordination checklist. Primary stakeholders: Sales field (AEs/SEs), CS Success Managers, Developer Relations, Docs, Engineering (runtime & ops), Design for visuals, and Marketing for messaging. Key objectives: reduce time-to-first-demo for field to <1 day, provide quantifiable cost/latency examples, and ensure messaging aligns with release notes and product docs.
acceptance_criteria: Battlecard PDF and editable slide deck with 2-page summary + challenge/solution/impact sections
FAQ doc with top 12 questions and approved technical answers from runtime team
Talk-track scripts: one 2-minute exec pitch, one 6-minute technical pitch
Three demo scripts with step-by-step actions, required console screenshots, sample prompts and expected outputs
Release-notes checklist signed-off by PM, Eng lead, and Docs (links to final release notes and changelog)
One internal training session scheduled and recorded with Q&A notes
